svg.title: Trinocular — SQL parse tree to Trino OPA authorization checks (Trino 484, Path B)
svg.text: SQL parse tree → Trino OPA authorization checks
Verified against Trino 484 (plugin/trino-opa) and the Ranger rego action map — enforcement Path B (OPA). Allow-only: no deny, union of grants.
policy-checked — the access type a grant must carry
always denied — the rego has no mapping, so no grant can allow it
own OPA endpoint; answered by the mask/filter provider (Workstream R)
(batch) filter op, evaluated per item † checked on catalog.schema ‡ checked on catalog
Grey text right of each section = the Ranger resource checked · grey tree node = not policy-checked
Inert: revoke (no op maps to it) · all (never expanded — use the concrete verbs)
Absent: read_sysinfo / write_sysinfo — their operations are denied on Path B
Grants name users and directory (LDAP) groups; the implicit group
public matches everyone. Roles are never matched on Path B,
and validity schedules are not enforced.
Grants to users and LDAP groups attach at
WHAT TRINO ASKS OPA FOR THIS QUERY
{ shipmode, extendedprice, discount, shipdate } — all columns read
GetRowFilters on lineitem → predicate ANDed into WHERE
GetColumnMask (batch) → at most one mask per column
Masks fail closed: two masks on one column ⇒ NULL
after AccessCatalog on memory (use) · denied ⇒ "Cannot execute function"
Decided inside the plugin — never sent to OPA
✕ GRANT / REVOKE / DENY on schemas and tables; CREATE / DROP ROLE; GRANT / REVOKE ROLE

text.tspan: opa.allow-permission-management-operations = false (default). true allows all of them, unchecked.

svg.text: ✓ SHOW ROLES, SHOW CURRENT ROLES, SHOW ROLE GRANTS — OPA holds no role information
✕ Branches: CREATE / DROP / FAST FORWARD / SHOW BRANCHES and branch privileges (SPI default)
✕ REFRESH VIEW and SET MATERIALIZED VIEW AUTHORIZATION (SPI default)
Changes from the legacy parse-tree diagram
+ CreateCatalog, DropCatalog, FilterCatalogs, AlterColumn, SetColumnComment, SetTableProperties,
− GrantTablePrivilege, RevokeTablePrivilege — never reach OPA (see left)
~ FilterColumns: select → always · GetColumnMask / row filter → provider · functions: execute or denied
~ FilterViewQueryOwnedBy moved to USER & QUERY · grants attach only at resource nodes, not SUM/AVG

Gaps flagged ✕ denied (unmapped in the rego) are candidates for Trinocular's rego work: CreateViewWithSelectFromColumns affects non-owners querying SECURITY DEFINER views; function listing/DDL and system information are unreachable.
